headline: Magnetism is one of the fundamental forces of nature—and still holds mysteries
universal_truth: Opposites attract; like repels like—in physics and often in life
fun_facts: Magnetism and electricity are two aspects of the same force: electromagnetism
Earth itself is a giant magnet, protecting us from solar radiation with its magnetic field
MRI machines use magnets 60,000 times stronger than Earth's magnetic field
discussion_questions: What invisible forces attract or repel things in your life?
How would the world change without magnetism?
What draws you toward certain people or ideas?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Hold two magnets together and feel them snap toward each other. Now flip one—and feel them push apart with surprising force. Nothing visible is happening. No contact is made. Yet something real is there. What is this invisible force?

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Magnets can push and pull through solid objects, through air, even through vacuum. They never touch, yet they exert real force. How can objects interact without any physical connection?

options.text: Moving electrons create invisible fields that extend into space
options.response: Exactly. Magnetism is caused by the spin and orbit of electrons creating fields.

options.text: Tiny particles flow between magnets to push or pull
options.response: Nothing physical flows—it's more subtle than that...

q1.title: Electron Spin
q1.script: Magnetism comes from electrons. Every electron spins, and that spin creates a tiny magnetic field. In most materials, spins point randomly and cancel out. In magnets, billions of electrons align their spins—and their tiny fields add up to something you can feel.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Electron Spin"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Earth's Shield
q2.script: Earth's iron core generates a magnetic field that extends thousands of miles into space. This invisible shield deflects solar radiation that would otherwise strip away our atmosphere. We owe our existence to the magnet beneath our feet.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Electromagnetism United
q3.script: In the 1800s, scientists discovered that electricity and magnetism are aspects of the same force. Move a magnet near wire—you get electricity. Run electricity through wire—you get magnetism. This unity powers motors, generators, and modern civilization.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Like magnets, we're drawn to some things and repelled by others—often without understanding why. Our attractions and aversions reveal something about our nature. Pay attention to what pulls you.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 34. Tomorrow, we'll explore how electricity flows through our world. Until then, find a magnet—on your fridge, perhaps—and feel that invisible push and pull.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Attraction Inventory - What Pulls You
growTrack.learning_objective: Examine what naturally attracts and repels you
growTrack.activity: List three things you're magnetically drawn to—activities, ideas, or people. Then list three things that repel you. What patterns do you notice? Our attractions often reveal our values and needs.
